table.name: TLGNR_SGROUP_BS
table.description: Reference data table for the Sales Group. No TX table needed.

column.name: SGROUP_CD
column.description: PK. A sales group. E.g. S01, S02, S03.

column.name: SGROUP_NAME
column.description: Name of the sales group, e.g. VA/S-Ostschweiz 01,N-Ostschweiz 03, ...

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: EMAIL_ADDRESSES
column.description: E-mail address(es) of the sales group. Used to notify the 'Kundenberater' (customer service representative) in case of Marketinfos received via PDA. Several e-mail addresses are possible, separated by comma.
